git_rationale.root_cause_commit: f8b208fa - feat: F1 LaTeX/Mermaid + F2 image upload (2026-03-23)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: The F1 LaTeX feature implemented only block-level display math ($$...$$). Inline $...$ was never added: parseMarkdownSpans.ts was not modified in f8b208fa (git show confirmed empty diff), MarkdownSpan type had no latex discriminant, and LatexRenderer was hardcoded to displayMode:true.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Adds the missing inline span recognition path end-to-end: regex case (span parser) -> latex discriminant (span type) -> displayMode:false KaTeX call (renderer). Block path remains untouched per BA spec and success criteria.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: The 159 lines added figure includes LatexRenderer.tsx's quality-gate-mandated refactor into helper components (its single 66-line Platform.OS==='web' branch exceeded the 30-line and 3-nesting-depth limits). The pure logical change is ~28 lines: latex flag on MarkdownSpan (1 line), regex case + two guard helpers + dispatch branch in parseMarkdownSpans (~20 lines of logic), inline? prop + <span> render path in LatexRenderer (~5 lines of logic), latex branch in MarkdownView RenderSpanItem (3 lines). The remaining diff is mechanical decomposition of pre-existing monolithic functions into memoized components without behavioural change.

blast_radius.impact_note: Added only an optional field; no changes to existing field shapes. All existing consumers continue to compile.
parseMarkdownSpans return shape unchanged (still MarkdownSpan[]). New spans have latex:true which existing callers ignore unless they check for it.
LatexRenderer props are backward-compatible (new inline prop is optional, defaults to false = block mode). Only one consumer (MarkdownView) imports it.

MarkdownView is used across 6 surfaces (conversation message view, subagent panel, tool full-view previews, changelog, artifacts). Because the change is an additive span-type dispatch (first match wins, no regression to existing branches), every surface automatically gains inline LaTeX without per-surface work. QA should spot-check: (1) conversation with inline math, (2) changelog for any $...$ occurrences (unlikely), (3) TaskView subagent conversation rendering.
